# HLT-C12 consistency proposal (A3, 17 November 2026)

Register decided under rules 1-8; checked against rules 1-13 (rule 11 revised).

## Changes
1. Rule 11. C1, C11 and C17 state the same thing in three places: therapeutic alliance is better in crisis houses (abstract Results, abstract Conclusions, Implications p.11). C2, C12 and C16 do the same for satisfaction. Each set becomes one new row that lists every location: C40 (rests on F1) and C41 (rests on F2). The six old rows are rejected. C11, C12, C16 and C17 each repeat a single result, so rule 2 does not apply to them.
2. The covers relations between repeats (R1, R2, R7, R8) are rejected, because after the merge they would link a claim to itself.
3. R3, R4, R5, R6, R16 and R17 are rejected and re-pointed to the merged rows as R21-R26 (C13 covers C40/C41; C40/C41 back C14; C37 covers C40/C41).
4. C37 and C38 stay under rule 2. C37 summarises several comparative results, and C38 summarises the satisfaction model (C6-C8). Neither repeats a single claim.
5. Rule 10. All endorsed backs relations are marked in the text: R5/R6 (now R23/R24) by "This finding provides", R10 by "Our findings also suggest", R11 by "Thus", R13 by "Thus". No change.
6. Rules 9, 12 and 13 do not apply. The NES items were developed with a consultation group, not from the study's own qualitative findings, and no qualitative data are compared across groups defined by a quantitative measure.

## Counts (before -> after)
- Headline claims: 33 -> 29
- Joint claims: 2 -> 2 (C18, C35)
- Claims in at least one endorsed relation: 19 (57.6%) -> 15 (51.7%)
- Clashes: 0 -> 0

Every endorsed relation links two endorsed claims (checked by script).

## Points for the author
1. C9 and C18 could be the same assertion: staff personal qualities shape the alliance. C9 says these qualities are among the factors (Q only); C18 says they are "crucial determinants" (joint). A merge under rule 11 would leave the joint count unchanged.
2. C10 and C34 (loss of liberty or autonomy damages the alliance) could also be one assertion. C34 adds that the result confirms earlier studies.
3. R10 has a weak marker. "Our findings also suggest" refers back to C18 across a paragraph about burnout.
